context.body: John’s baptism remembered · later memory · Acts 19:1–7
context.label: John’s baptism remembered

observations.body: Paul meets disciples who know John’s baptism but have not heard of the Holy Spirit; he restates John’s forward-pointing message before baptism in Jesus’ name.
observations.label: Disciples in Ephesus move beyond John’s baptism

observations.body: The passage presents Questioning, baptizing, laying hands, and speaking as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Questioning, baptizing, laying hands, and speaking

payload.posture: Read Acts 19:1–7 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul meets disciples who know John’s baptism but have not heard of the Holy Spirit; he restates John’s forward-pointing message before baptism in Jesus’ name. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
payload.title: Disciples in Ephesus move beyond John’s baptism
